_about: Invented sample of a person's standing preferences, the kind the corrections-list prototype pulls from chat history. The browser attaches these to every request; the page never sees them.
preferences: Sign off every email as M. and never with my full name
Keep email replies under 80 words because I read them on my phone
Never use exclamation marks in anything written for me
When offering meeting times, take them from my calendar file and offer exactly three
Mention that I am hard of hearing and prefer text over phone calls only to people I already know
